primary_source_citation.title: LIA Skiving Blade & Mallet Tool Safety Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Rotary punches, skivers, and knives must cut away from fingers on a high-density poly board or end-grain wood block to protect blades.
core_mechanism_bullets: Rotary punches, skivers, and knives must cut away from fingers on a high-density poly board or end-grain wood block to protect blades.
Stamping tools and steel drive punches are struck with rawhide, poly, or wood mallets, never steel hammers that mushroom tool shafts.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: When punching 0.125-inch belt holes with a steel drive punch, placing a scrap piece of 8-ounce cowhide over a poly poundo board protects the hardened steel cutting edge.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Demonstrate safe hand placement behind the cutting line with a swivel knife and compare a rawhide mallet against a poly maul on a leather stamping block.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: LIA Skiving Blade & Mallet Tool Safety Standard: Rotary punches, skivers, and knives must cut away from fingers on a high-density poly board or end-grain wood block to protect blades. Stamping tools and steel drive punches are struck with rawhide, poly, or wood mallets, never steel hammers that mushroom tool shafts.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Leather thickness is measured in ounces where 1 ounce equals 1/64 inch (0.4 mm), from 2 oz wallet linings to 9 oz heavy belt leather.
core_mechanism_bullets: Leather thickness is measured in ounces where 1 ounce equals 1/64 inch (0.4 mm), from 2 oz wallet linings to 9 oz heavy belt leather.
Full-grain leather retains the dense outer epidermis fiber layer for top strength, whereas suede split comes from the underside corium.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: A Scout crafting a heavy-duty outdoor belt selects an 8-to-9-ounce full-grain vegetable-tanned cowhide strap measuring 8/64 inch (1/8 inch) thick from the dense bend area of the hide.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Measure four leather swatches with a leather ounce gauge wheel and identify cattlehide, deerskin, goatskin, full-grain, and suede split samples.

primary_source_citation.title: LIA Vegetable vs Chrome Tanning & Casing Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Vegetable tanning uses natural tree-bark tannins over 30 to 60 days to produce firm tooling leather that holds stamped impressions.
core_mechanism_bullets: Vegetable tanning uses natural tree-bark tannins over 30 to 60 days to produce firm tooling leather that holds stamped impressions.
Chromium(III) mineral tanning finishes in 24 to 48 hours, yielding soft, water-resistant garment and boot leather that cannot be tooled.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Properly casing 6-ounce vegetable-tanned cowhide requires dampening the grain with a sponge and waiting 5 to 10 minutes until the surface returns toward its natural tan color while remaining cool to the touch.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Case a vegetable-tanned leather coaster with a damp sponge, wait for proper moisture equilibrium, cut a swivel-knife border, and bevel and stamp a basketweave pattern.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: LIA Vegetable vs Chrome Tanning & Casing Standard: Vegetable tanning uses natural tree-bark tannins over 30 to 60 days to produce firm tooling leather that holds stamped impressions. Chromium(III) mineral tanning finishes in 24 to 48 hours, yielding soft, water-resistant garment and boot leather that cannot be tooled.

primary_source_citation.title: LIA Two-Needle Saddle Stitch & Plaiting Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: A two-needle saddle stitch passes waxed thread from opposite sides through each awl hole in a figure-8 so one broken stitch still holds.
core_mechanism_bullets: A two-needle saddle stitch passes waxed thread from opposite sides through each awl hole in a figure-8 so one broken stitch still holds.
Four-strand leather braiding alternates outer strands over one and under one at even tension, finished by burnishing edges with a slicker.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Unlike a sewing machine lockstitch that unzips if the bobbin thread snaps, a hand-sewn saddle stitch at 6 stitches per inch holds a knife sheath together even if one thread wears through.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Demonstrate a 4-strand round plait with contrasting lace strands and sew a 2-inch two-needle saddle stitch seam in pre-punched leather strips.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: LIA Two-Needle Saddle Stitch & Plaiting Standard: A two-needle saddle stitch passes waxed thread from opposite sides through each awl hole in a figure-8 so one broken stitch still holds. Four-strand leather braiding alternates outer strands over one and under one at even tension, finished by burnishing edges with a slicker.
